issues.title: Landing light switch feed (W045) is too thin for its breaker
issues.message: W045: 22 AWG is protected by CB-LANDING-LT 10 A; at most 5 A per FAA AC 43.13-1B, Table 11-3 (wire and circuit protector chart)
issues.fix: use a breaker of 5 A or less, or a heavier gauge

issues.title: Transponder supply (W058) is too thin for its breaker
issues.message: W058: 20 AWG is protected by CB-XPDR 15 A; at most 7.5 A per FAA AC 43.13-1B, Table 11-3 (wire and circuit protector chart)
issues.fix: use a breaker of 7.5 A or less, or a heavier gauge

issues.title: 3 antenna cables have no known signal direction
issues.message: An antenna and a radio have no one-way signal; nothing to fix.
issues.fix: add pin types (signal_in / signal_out) to the part data, or direction.senders / receivers patterns
